nodes.label: Digvation Lifecycle Claude Code Entry Contract
nodes.norm_label: digvation lifecycle claude code entry contract

nodes.label: Delivery, Git, Versioning and Deployment Standard
nodes.norm_label: delivery, git, versioning and deployment standard

nodes.label: REUSE -> EXTEND -> NEW
nodes.rationale: Avoid duplicate abstractions created because it is faster for one task; create new only when ownership is genuinely different.

nodes.label: READY_FOR_MANUAL_REVIEW Gate
nodes.rationale: Implementation ready for inspection is not approval; stop and wait for APPROVE/REJECT before commit/push/merge.

nodes.label: Source-of-Truth Precedence
nodes.rationale: Resolves conflicts: user decision > AGENTS.md > accepted architecture > repo contracts > historical docs > old prompts.

nodes.label: Codebase Memory MCP Discovery Layer
nodes.rationale: Structural discovery before broad grep; each nested repo is its own graph; findings verified against source.

nodes.label: Conditional Standards Reading
nodes.rationale: Save tokens; do not recursively read all standards for ordinary work.

nodes.label: Documentation Creation Gate
nodes.rationale: Temporary implementation narration belongs in chat/PR/commit history, not new repository documents.

nodes.label: Model Routing (TERRA MEDIUM / TERRA HIGH / SOL)
nodes.norm_label: model routing (terra medium / terra high / sol)

nodes.label: Automatic Specialist Skill Routing
nodes.rationale: Skills are supporting capabilities that never override contract, AGENTS.md, or accepted architecture.

nodes.label: Ownership Classification Before Implementation
nodes.rationale: Repository names are not ownership authority; use narrowest correct owner.

nodes.label: No Planning Labels in Production Artifacts
nodes.norm_label: no planning labels in production artifacts

nodes.label: start-claude.ps1
nodes.rationale: Starting from lifecycle root ensures shared Digvation skills are discovered.

nodes.label: UI Authority Order
nodes.rationale: Design System and repo components win over ui-ux-pro-max and generic guidance.

nodes.label: Remote Mutation Gate
nodes.rationale: Never infer approval from silence or passing checks; feature completion is not deploy authorization.

nodes.label: Digvation CORE Control Plane
nodes.rationale: CORE owns commercial/installation/runtime metadata and never business-domain transactions; not a synchronous dependency for every transaction.

nodes.label: Backoffice Experience
nodes.rationale: Shared "manage the business" experience; not a separately sold product.

nodes.label: Operational Experience
nodes.rationale: Shared "run the business now" experience.

nodes.label: Finance / Financial Operations Capability
nodes.rationale: Independent from POS; enabled by FINANCE_OPERATIONS entitlement.

nodes.label: Tax / Fiscal Shared Capability
nodes.rationale: Avoid drifting per-domain tax engines; preserve applied rule snapshot.

nodes.label: Visible Capability Composition (Entitlement / Runtime / Permission / Location intersection)
nodes.rationale: UI visibility is not authorization; businessType is not entitlement authority.
nodes.norm_label: visible capability composition (entitlement / runtime / permission / location intersection)

nodes.label: Effective Entitlement Set
nodes.rationale: SaaS plan names are packaging, not runtime authorization; CORE resolves an explicit set.

nodes.label: Deployment Dimensions (Isolation / Infra Owner / Management / Branding)
nodes.rationale: Do not create a single clientType enum mixing dimensions.
nodes.norm_label: deployment dimensions (isolation / infra owner / management / branding)

nodes.label: White-Label Branding
nodes.rationale: Branding config, not a product or source fork.

nodes.label: No Direct Cross-Domain Database/Repository Access
nodes.rationale: Holds even when domains are colocated; adapters may later become HTTP/message based without changing ownership.

nodes.label: Business Configuration
nodes.rationale: Owned by Business Runtime; may hide but never grant entitlement.

nodes.label: Scope Contracts (scopes/ catalog)
nodes.rationale: Living domain catalog so domains are added without rewriting ecosystem architecture; Deferred/Planned is not implementation authority.

nodes.label: ProductCapability Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Catalog compatibility, not proof a Client owns the capability.

nodes.label: AddOnOffering
nodes.rationale: Premium add-ons scoped to a Product; price not attached directly to ProductFeature.

nodes.label: SubscriptionTerm / SubscriptionAddOn Price Snapshots
nodes.rationale: Catalog price changes must not rewrite client price snapshots.

nodes.label: Client Onboarding (Create & Provision)
nodes.rationale: One operator action backed by multiple owned idempotent backend steps.

nodes.label: Frontend Invariants
nodes.rationale: No JS-number monetary authority; no businessType branching; generated API code not hand-edited.

nodes.label: Backend/Domain Ownership Classification
nodes.rationale: Historical POS placement does not make POS owner of Inventory/Workshop/Finance.

nodes.label: Build Once, Promote
nodes.rationale: Promote exact immutable artifact that passed staging instead of rebuilding.

nodes.label: Supported Deployment Modes (Dedicated-Digvation / Dedicated-Client / Shared SaaS)
nodes.norm_label: supported deployment modes (dedicated-digvation / dedicated-client / shared saas)

nodes.label: Clean Architecture Dependency Discipline
nodes.rationale: Dependency/ownership boundaries, not folder cosplay.

nodes.label: Dead Code Policy
nodes.rationale: Git history is the archive.

nodes.label: Server Portability
nodes.rationale: Replacement server converges to baseline without undocumented manual history.

nodes.label: Security Validation Levels (A/B/C)
nodes.rationale: Risk-based: small UI changes do not need a pentest.

nodes.label: Current Business Focus
nodes.rationale: Directional only; current user task is the implementation boundary.

nodes.label: Operational Access & Location Context Scope Contract
nodes.norm_label: operational access & location context scope contract

nodes.label: Effective Entitlement Set
nodes.rationale: Runtime/frontend consume the entitlement set resolved by CORE/control-plane; never infer availability from plan name, business type, deployment mode, branding or source-code presence.

nodes.label: Commercial Packaging (packaging hint, not authorization)
nodes.rationale: Packaging may change commercially without changing domain ownership.

nodes.label: Scope Status Vocabulary (ACTIVE / NEXT / PLANNED / DRAFT)
nodes.rationale: A scope contract is not a roadmap authorization; Deferred/Planned items require explicit task activation.
nodes.norm_label: scope status vocabulary (active / next / planned / draft)

nodes.label: Agent Reading Rule
nodes.rationale: Keep context lean: read only the applicable AGENTS.md and one or two materially involved scope contracts, then verify with Codebase Memory MCP.

nodes.label: Audit/Activity Record (append-only, business-semantic)
nodes.rationale: Records business meaning (e.g. EMPLOYEE_DEACTIVATED) rather than raw HTTP verbs/routes; not a replacement for logs/tracing/analytics.

nodes.label: Audit Sensitive Data Rules
nodes.rationale: Never store secrets, tokens, full card data or credentials in audit payloads.

nodes.label: Catalog Pricing Boundary
nodes.rationale: Final transaction price, discounts, promotions and tax remain backend-authoritative in the owning transactional capability; Catalog must not silently become a pricing engine.

nodes.label: Membership (enrollment/status)
nodes.rationale: Membership is enrollment into a business program; paid subscription billing is deferred.

nodes.label: Loyalty Point Ledger (PointLedgerEntry)
nodes.rationale: Ledger is durable historical authority; refunds append EARN_REVERSAL rather than rewriting history; cached balance allowed only for performance.

nodes.label: Loyalty Rule Precedence (Catalog-specific FIXED_POINTS/EXCLUDED over Default Spend Rule)
nodes.norm_label: loyalty rule precedence (catalog-specific fixed_points/excluded over default spend rule)

nodes.label: Dashboard Composition Authority (Entitlement ∩ Runtime ∩ Permission ∩ Location ∩ Projection)
nodes.norm_label: dashboard composition authority (entitlement ∩ runtime ∩ permission ∩ location ∩ projection)

nodes.label: Domain Projection Contribution Model
nodes.rationale: Shared experience decides layout; the owning domain decides meaning and authoritative data contract of its metric/report.

nodes.label: Cross-Domain Report Rule (explicit projection contract, no table joins)
nodes.norm_label: cross-domain report rule (explicit projection contract, no table joins)

nodes.label: Payment-to-Financial-Account Routing
nodes.rationale: Unique per selling location, payment method and currency; payment methods are not independent destinations.

nodes.label: Settlement / Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Reconciliation deferred until external settlement evidence and cash-session boundary are activated.

nodes.label: Cashier Session Boundary
nodes.rationale: POS owns drawer/session state; Finance owns movement beyond it; crossed only via explicit payment/financial integration contract.

nodes.label: Role / Permission (Owner/Manager/Staff)
nodes.rationale: Prefer composable permissions over an ever-growing global role enum.

nodes.label: Core Separation: Employee vs Account vs Role vs Operational Access
nodes.rationale: Keep authorities distinct; do not duplicate Employee records for logins or branch assignment.
nodes.norm_label: core separation: employee vs account vs role vs operational access

nodes.label: Operational Location Access Assignment
nodes.rationale: Do not model access as one permanent branchId on Account; accounts may operate in multiple locations.

nodes.label: Manager Location-Scoped Access
nodes.rationale: Manager title never implies access to every branch; explicit assignment required per location.

nodes.label: Business Profile
nodes.rationale: Single tenant business identity; deployment branding may seed but not override it.

nodes.label: Business Preferences Aggregate (versioned, typed)
nodes.rationale: Not an unrestricted JSON blob; must not hold entitlement, permission, location, tax-rule or financial authority.

nodes.label: Single-/Multi-Branch Canonical Shape
nodes.rationale: No singleBranchMode fork; same canonical model for one or many locations.

nodes.label: Promotion Benefit Types (percentage, fixed, bonus points, multiplier)
nodes.norm_label: promotion benefit types (percentage, fixed, bonus points, multiplier)

nodes.label: Promotion Stacking Policy (monetary non-stackable by default)
nodes.rationale: Avoid complex combinability engine in first checkpoint; deterministic priority chooses one monetary promotion.
nodes.norm_label: promotion stacking policy (monetary non-stackable by default)

nodes.label: Integrated Membership + Loyalty + Promotion Suite
nodes.rationale: Presented cohesively in Backoffice but services/models preserve ownership boundaries.

nodes.label: Service Appointment
nodes.rationale: Scheduling is not a generic reservation engine; initial salon case kept business-generic.

nodes.label: Tax Rule Evaluation Contract
nodes.rationale: Context-aware rather than hard-coded per product; not duplicated per domain.

nodes.label: Historical Tax Result Snapshot
nodes.rationale: Reports read immutable transaction tax facts rather than recalculating with today's rules.

nodes.label: Employee Identity (canonical)
nodes.rationale: One canonical employee identity; domain profiles like MechanicProfile stay in owning domain.

nodes.label: Work Order / Vehicle / Mechanic Execution (boundary envelope)
nodes.norm_label: work order / vehicle / mechanic execution (boundary envelope)
